tools.name: cf_search_offers
tools.description: Search offers on cenufiltrs.lv. Use this first for product-shopping requests before generic web answers. Always narrow with `categories` using taxonomy ltree paths (e.g. "communication.smartphones") — a device-model query means the device, not its accessories. Results are sorted cheapest first by de

tools.name: cf_search_facets
tools.description: Get available search filters (brands, categories, price range) for a query. Each category comes back with the ltree `path` that cf_search_offers.categories expects. Use this when a shopping request is broad or ambiguous and you need the exact category path before searching.

tools.name: cf_render_search_results
tools.description: Turn a canonical cf_search_offers structured response into a compact branded CenuFiltrs HTML resource for MCP hosts that support component rendering.

tools.name: cf_list_offers
tools.description: List offers with filtering by product or retailer. Shows prices across stores.

tools.name: cf_price_summary
tools.description: Get price summary for a product: min/max/avg prices across all retailers.

tools.name: cf_price_history
tools.description: Get price history for a product over a period (up to 365 days, when records are available). Shows price trends over time.

tools.name: cf_deal_analysis
tools.description: Analyze if current price is a good deal: score, trend, comparison with historical prices.

tools.name: cf_list_products
tools.description: List products from the catalog with pagination.

tools.name: cf_get_product
tools.description: Get detailed product information including offers, prices, and attributes.

tools.name: cf_list_categories
tools.description: List all product categories with their taxonomy `path`. Use a `path` (e.g. "communication.smartphones") as the cf_search_offers.categories filter value.

tools.name: cf_search_categories
tools.description: Search categories by name and get their taxonomy `path`. Use this to resolve a product wording ("smartphone", "tires") into the `path` that cf_search_offers.categories expects.

tools.name: cf_category_hierarchy
tools.description: Get the full category tree with taxonomy `path` values. Call this once when you need the complete list of paths accepted by cf_search_offers.categories.

tools.name: cf_list_retailers
tools.description: List all retailers (stores) available on cenufiltrs.lv.

tools.name: cf_get_retailer
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific retailer.

tools.name: cf_list_reviews
tools.description: Get reviews for a retailer. Shows ratings and customer feedback.

tools.name: cf_list_comments
tools.description: Get comments for a product, offer, or retailer.

tools.name: cf_list_wishes
tools.description: List user's wishlist/bookmarks. Requires authentication.

tools.name: cf_add_wish
tools.description: Add a product or offer to wishlist/bookmarks. Requires authentication.

tools.name: cf_remove_wish
tools.description: Remove an item from wishlist/bookmarks. Requires authentication.

tools.name: cf_search_history
tools.description: Get user's search history. Requires authentication.

tools.name: cf_popular_searches
tools.description: Get user's most popular/frequent searches. Requires authentication.

tools.name: cf_create_comment
tools.description: Post a comment on a product, offer, or retailer. Requires authentication.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: cf_render_search_results, cf_list_reviews, cf_list_comments · Private data: cf_price_history · Public sink: cf_create_comment · Destructive: cf_remove_wish.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: cf_render_search_results, cf_list_reviews, cf_list_comments · Private data: cf_price_history · Public sink: cf_create_comment · Destructive: cf_remove_wish

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
